description: Read one matching offer by its id, which is keyless, or list the offers one wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make, oldest first. For each: sponsor_signed, matched, exhausted, expired or revoked and why, the ratio and the cap in NET units, what is applied and what is left, and every match applied against the cap (the funder, the worker and the acceptor the board named, and whether it stands or was reversed). To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held: an offer is a record, never custody and never a lock. A private district place shows no name and no exact pin. Free; a read by id is keyless, and a list is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

matchId.description: The offer's id (the matchId it was committed under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a sponsor, to list its offers. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_match_status
title: Where a sponsor's matching offer stands, or every offer one wallet holds (a signed read)
